purpose: Measure the accepted stock and rejected local stage-zero PHY without decoded-payload spectral bias, and inventory the complete pre-assignment RF windows without a sync-word filter.

method.waveform: Recover the 319 transitions in the 320-symbol alternating wake, then take the median instantaneous frequency from the interior half of every symbol so both FSK tones receive equal weight.
method.normalization: Subtract the valve factory-request center from the assignment center in the same capture session before comparing stock and local transmitters.
method.inventory: Threshold raw complex magnitude across the complete bounded window before the factory request; do not require a RainPoint sync word or decoded frame.

pre_assignment_inventory.conclusion: No stock-only unframed transmission was detectable anywhere in the captured 2 MHz band before the accepted assignment.

interpretation: The previous unconstrained FFT comparison selected data-dependent sidebands and incorrectly declared stock and local carrier/deviation equal.
Accepted stock uses the CC1101 0x45 deviation family for the assignment; rejected local probe .22 used 0x43.
Local probe .22 was 35.370 kHz low after normalizing against the same valve oscillator, so absolute center comparisons across sessions were not a valid calibration loop.
Symbol rate, 320-symbol wake length, decoded assignment bytes apart from clock and CRC, endpoints, selector, scheduling, polarity, and one-shot state remain frozen for probe .23.
If probe .23 still fails stage zero after an on-air waveform check, the next discriminator is exact replay of a freshly accepted stock assignment; do not resume blind timing or field changes.
